business_summary: Unbanked,Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the gold bullion trading and related businesses in Japan. It operates through two segments: Gold Bullion and Non-Bank. The company is also involved in precious metals spot trading; gold investment/trading; corporate loans; loan-type crowdfunding; real estate secured loans; money lending; and investment and consulting business. In addition, it provides access to blockchain-powered financial products; and on-chain services. Further, the company offers face-to-face sales and purchase services for gold bullion bars; and management of group companies and related operations, as well as online gold spot trading and savings services. The company was formerly known as Daiichi Commodities Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Unbanked,Inc. in July 2025. Unbanked,Inc. was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.
